notes: Covers semantics.md §3.1 — the case TradeStation produces whenever it is
not in live mode. EL's InsideBid/InsideAsk return 0 during historical
replay and for symbols that carry no quote at all, and the publisher
normalises any non-positive value to JSON null.
The point of this fixture is that null appears ON THE WIRE. Compare with
smoke.jsonl, where VXX carries real numbers and the binding is the one
that has to invalidate them (§3.2). Both paths end at the same place; only
one of them can be got wrong by reading the schema alone.
The SPY tick is why this fixture needs a second symbol. $TICK alone cannot
separate §3.1 from §3.2: a binding that ignores wire nulls entirely still
blanks $TICK's quotes under §3.2 and passes. SPY is not on the index list,
so nothing rescues it — the wire null is the only reason its bid/ask are
absent, and reading 0.0 here is the exact failure the rule exists for.
$TICK also has vol 0 here, which is what a breadth index reports. Any VWAP
derived from it must be null rather than a division by zero (§3.4).
